protocol.choice: Condition each normalized h*derivative family on the 64 initial point values. E=D-C Wpp^dagger B, T=I-B^T Wpp^dagger B. For probe v choose u proportional to T^dagger E^T v. Matrix control maximizes ||Eu||^2/(u^T T u). Choices at all centers condition only on the original point set, not on each other.
protocol.probes: current literal r8; initial b; independent seeded Gaussian; matrix-only conditional derivative energy. Combine point and derivative features using the FULL joint covariance, including offdiagonal cross-center derivative covariance.
protocol.comparison: Common x8 restart for all derivative controls and point64/128/512. Initial-b and matrix derivatives also upfront; current-final-set-upfront is explicitly hindsight. Static point128/512 also upfront.
protocol.cost: Dense cached K, derivatives, selection, eigendecomposition and factors are free diagnostic assistance. Every iterate is checked against the original system. All products reported, including separate verification/boundary counts. Prefix cost recorded separately. NOT complete-cost, fixed-memory or native-runtime evidence. No resource contract adopted.
protocol.decision: If current directional selection does not improve subsequent convergence relative to initial/random/matrix/point controls enough to justify pricing, close this selector without rank/checkpoint tuning. No full-scope success or heldout use.
